title: See Mardi Gras floats taking shape

location.label: Mardi Gras World, New Orleans, Louisiana

description: Walk through Mardi Gras World’s working float den, where artists build the giant props and painted scenes that later roll through New Orleans. A guide explains the process as you pass pieces at different stages of completion. Seeing the figures up close gives you a new sense of scale when you meet them again on a parade route.
teaser: Go inside the workshop where parade floats are made.
goodToKnow: Indoor walking and standing; ask about a manageable tour and seating.
whyItMightDelightYou: It lets you meet the makers behind the spectacle and notice their work before the crowds arrive.
